# Harbor Directory — brief for Codex

Context: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-crows-nest-design.md. Luke (entry-level boat operator, Myrtle Beach SC) needs
a SHORT, actionable list of local employers to call / walk in to, because local boat jobs are rarely posted online.
Source data: config/local-employers.json (~219 entries, too many). Do NOT git commit. Keep all tests passing; add tests.

## 1. Condense → data/directory.json (generated by new script scripts/build-directory.mjs, `npm run directory`)
- Merge duplicates/chains (same company or same careers URL → one entry, towns joined).
- Exclude: cruise lines, pure retail/dealers with no boat-crew roles, repair-only shops, shipyards needing trade
  certs, anything with no usable contact (no phone, email, careers URL or website).
- Score each: +3 entry-level boat crew employer (charters, fishing/head boats, dolphin/sightseeing tours, parasail/jet
  ski, boat clubs, marinas/dry stack, ferries/water taxis, towing/TowBoatUS/Sea Tow, tall ships, harbor tours);
  +2 near home (grand-strand), +1 charleston; +1 hires by walk-in/phone/email (local) or careers page; +1 has phone.
  Florida region: keep only yacht crew agencies, day-work resources and live-aboard deckhand employers.
- Output `{ generatedAt, about, employers: [{ id (slug), name, region: "grand-strand"|"charleston"|"florida",
  town, type, hiringMethod, phone, email, url, tier: "top"|"more", score, tip }] }` where tier "top" = best 14
  Grand Strand + 10 Charleston + 6 Florida (30 total), everything else that survived = "more". `tip` = one short
  sentence on how to approach (e.g. "Walk in before 9am with resume; ask for the dock master").
- Do not invent phones/emails/URLs — only what's in the research data.

## 2. UI: new tab "Harbor" (hash #harbor), icon ⚓-style glyph consistent with other tabs; must fit the phone bottom bar
  (6 items at 360px — shrink labels/icons as needed, no horizontal scroll).
- Default view: Top picks grouped by region (Grand Strand, Charleston, Florida) with counts; toggle "Show all (N)";
  search box; filter chips by status.
- Card: name, town · type, how they hire, tip, phone/email as selectable text with copy buttons, website link
  (safeUrl, target=_blank). Status chips: Not yet / Called / Walked in / Applied / No openings / Follow up.
  Optional note. "Add to Voyage" button → creates a Dockside tracker job (company=name, role "Ask about deckhand /
  dock crew", track marine-local for grand-strand, marine-chs for charleston, marine-national for florida,
  contact phone/email copied, link=url) and marks the card "On board".
- Status/notes persist in tracker.json under `directory: { [employerId]: { status, note, updatedAt } }`;
  update mergeTrackers to merge this map per key by updatedAt (test it). Seed tracker has `directory: {}`.
- Progress line at top: "12 of 30 top picks contacted" with a small bar — Luke needs visible progress.
- Load data/directory.json like the feed (cache-buster; failure → friendly empty state).
- All third-party text via textContent only.

## Finish
npm run directory, npm test all passing, short summary with the 30 top picks (name — town — why).
